answer: Refactoring the core could potentially break several files, particularly those with high blast values. Specifically, files like crates/core/flags/defs.rs, crates/core/flags/hiargs.rs, and crates/core/flags/lowargs.rs have blast values of 7 or higher, indicating they are likely to break if changes are made. Additionally, the interdependencies with files such as crates/core/main.rs could also lead to issues during refactoring.
